blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate counting and localization of plants and their organs support phenotyping and yield estimation, yet target appearance, scale, and density vary widely across species and imaging conditions. Exemplar boxes specify the target without category-specific retraining, and point predictions identify the individual instances contributing to the count. We introduce AgriCountDINO, a parameter-efficient exemplar-guided framework for joint counting and localization. It conditions frozen multiscale DINOv3 features on exemplar appearance and size, then progressively decodes them into target points. Missed-object recovery extends supervision to targets overlooked by initial matching, and exemplar-adaptive point NMS filters duplicate predictions according to exemplar scale. With 8.4M trainable parameters, approximately one-tenth of TasselNetV4’s, AgriCountDINO achieves a three-shot MAE of 11.92 on the TPC-268 benchmark, reducing counting error by 9.7% while providing individual target locations. Trained only on TPC-268, it achieves a zero-shot MAE of 14.25 on unseen generic object categories in FSC-147, improving upon the best compared zero-shot method by 6.0% without target-domain training or fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 对植物及其器官进行精确的计数和本地化,有助于对树皮和产量进行估计,但目标外观、规模和密度因物种和成像条件而大不相同。 实例框指定目标,而不进行特定类别的再培训,点预测则识别有助于计数的个别实例. 我们引入了AgriContDINO,这是联合计数和本地化的参数高效的示例指导框架. 它在实例外观和尺寸上将多尺度的DINov3特性条件冻结,然后逐渐解码为目标点. 缺失对象恢复将监管延伸到初始匹配忽略的目标,实例适应点NMS过滤器按照实例尺度重复预测. AgriContDINO使用8.4M的可训练参数,大约十分之一的TasselNetV4,在TPC-268基准上实现了11.92的三发MAE,在提供单个目标位置的同时将计数错误减少9.7%. 它只在TPC-268上接受过训练,在FSC-147的未见通用对象类别上实现了14.25的零射MAE,在未进行目标领域训练或微调的情况下,比最佳的零射法提高了6.0%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate counting and localization of plants and their organs are fundamental to agricultural image analysis. Count estimates support yield estimation and phenotyping, while instance locations enable spatial analysis and inspection of individual predictions. Agricultural targets vary substantially across species, organs, growth stages, scales, and imaging conditions, making it difficult to extend category-specific models to diverse targets [ 5 ] . This diversity motivates exemplar-guided approaches, in which a few visual examples specify the objects of interest without requiring a separate model for each target category.
blocks.zh: 对植物及其器官进行准确的计算和本地化是农业形象分析的基础。 计算估计支持产量估计和螺旋化,而实例位置则有利于对单个预测进行空间分析和检查。 不同物种、器官、生长阶段、规模和成像条件的农业目标差异很大,因此难以将特定类别的模型扩大到不同的目标[5]。 这种多样性激发了以实例为指南的方法,其中少数视觉例子具体说明了感兴趣的对象,而不需要为每个目标类别制定单独的模型。

blocks.en: Recent counting methods can return individual target locations through point predictions, detections, or segmentation masks [ 15 , 9 , 12 , 11 ] . In agriculture, TasselNet introduced local count regression for maize tassels [ 8 ] , while TasselNetV4 combined local counting with exemplar guidance to address variation across scenes, scales, and species [ 5 ] . TPC-268 provides exemplar boxes and point annotations for hundreds of fine-grained plant categories [ 17 ] , allowing counting and localization to be evaluated together across diverse agricultural targets.
blocks.zh: 最近的计数方法可以通过点预测,检测,或分解口罩返回单个目标位置[15,9,12,11]. 在农业方面,TasselNet引入了玉米泰瑟的当地计数回归[8],而TasselNetV4将当地计数与实例指导相结合,以解决场景、尺度和物种之间的变异[5]. TPC-268为数百种精细的植物类别提供了示例盒和点评说明[17],使得计数和本地化可以在不同的农业目标中一起评价.

blocks.en: TasselNetV4’s local-count predictions, however, do not explicitly identify individual targets. Exemplar-guided counting depends on relating the supplied examples to corresponding regions in the image [ 13 ] . To also localize targets, these correspondences must retain the spatial detail needed to distinguish nearby instances as plant appearance and size vary. Self-supervised visual encoders provide transferable representations [ 1 , 2 ] ; DINOv3, in particular, offers dense features that provide a basis for learning such correspondences [ 14 ] . This motivates AgriCountDINO 1 1 1 https://github.com/Shengjie-Guo/AgriCountDINO , an exemplar-guided framework for joint plant counting and localization.
blocks.zh: 塔塞尔网 然而,V4的当地统计预测并未明确确定个别目标。 实际指导性计算取决于在图像中将提供的例子与相应区域联系起来[13]。 为使目标本地化,这些函证必须保留所需的空间细节,以区分植物外观和大小各不相同的附近情况。 自我监督的视觉编码器提供可转移的表示[1,2];特别是DINOv3,提供了密集的特征,为学习这种函证提供基础[14]. 这激励了AgriCountDINO 1 1 1 https://github.com/Sengjie-Guo/AgriCountDINO,这是联合植物计数和本地化的示范性指导框架.

blocks.en: AgriCountDINO uses a frozen DINOv3-pretrained encoder [ 14 , 6 ] to extract multiscale image features. Exemplar appearance and size condition these features, which are fused from coarse to fine and decoded into instance points. Training updates only the exemplar-conditioning, fusion, and prediction modules. Missed-object recovery supervises annotated targets overlooked by initial peak matching. At inference, the exemplar scale determines which nearby point predictions are suppressed as duplicates. The retained points specify individual target locations, and their number gives the count. Counting and point-localization results on diverse plant categories, together with zero-shot transfer to unseen generic objects, suggest that the model captures transferable visual and semantic correspondences between exemplars and targets.
blocks.zh: AgriContDINO使用冷冻的DINOv3预装编码器[14,6]来提取多尺度的图像特性. 实例外观和大小对这些特征有条件,这些特征从粗细到细,并解码为实例点。 培训仅更新实例-空调、聚变和预测模块。 错误对象恢复 监管初始峰值匹配忽略的附加说明的目标 。 推论,示例尺度决定了附近哪些点的预测被压制为重复. 保留点指定了单个目标位置,其数量给出了计数. 计数结果和点定位结果在不同的植物类别上,加上零射转录到看不见的通用物体上,表明模型捕捉到实例与目标之间的可转移视觉和语义对应.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce AgriCountDINO, an exemplar-guided model that counts and localizes diverse plants and plant organs with only 8.4M trainable parameters. • We develop multiscale point prediction guided by exemplar appearance and size, with missed-object recovery during training and exemplar-adaptive duplicate suppression at inference. • AgriCountDINO achieves a three-shot validation MAE of 11.92 on TPC-268, 9.7% below TasselNetV4, and a zero-shot MAE of 14.25 on FSC-147, 6.0% below the strongest compared zero-shot method.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们引进了AgriContDINO,这是一种典型的制导模型,它只计算8.4M可训练参数的不同植物和植物器官并使之本地化。 我们以实例的外观和大小为导向,进行多尺度点预测,在训练时进行漏出物体恢复,推论时进行实例适应性的重复抑制. • AgriContDINO在TPC-268上实现了11.92的MAE三发验证,低于TasselNetV49.7%,在FSC-147上实现了14.25的MAE零发验证,低于最强的比零发验证方法6.0%.

blocks.en: We introduce AgriCountDINO, an exemplar-guided model that counts and localizes diverse plants and plant organs with only 8.4M trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了AgriCountDINO, 一种典型的制导模型, 它计算和本地化了各种植物和植物器官,只有8.4M可训练参数。

blocks.en: We develop multiscale point prediction guided by exemplar appearance and size, with missed-object recovery during training and exemplar-adaptive duplicate suppression at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们以实例的外观和大小为导向,进行多尺度点预测,在训练时进行漏出物体恢复,推论时进行实例适应性的重复抑制.

blocks.en: AgriCountDINO achieves a three-shot validation MAE of 11.92 on TPC-268, 9.7% below TasselNetV4, and a zero-shot MAE of 14.25 on FSC-147, 6.0% below the strongest compared zero-shot method.
blocks.zh: AgriContDINO在TPC-268上实现了11.92的MAE三发验证,比TasselNetV4低9.7%,在FSC-147上实现了14.25的MAE零发验证,比最强的零发验证方法低6.0%.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multiscale Exemplar Conditioning
blocks.zh: 2.1 多尺度试验条件

blocks.en: A frozen DINOv3-pretrained encoder [ 14 , 6 ] extracts four feature maps. For a 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 input, C 1 , C 2 , C 3 , C 4 C_{1},C_{2},C_{3},C_{4} have sizes 256 2 × 128 256^{2}\times 128 , 128 2 × 256 128^{2}\times 256 , 64 2 × 512 64^{2}\times 512 , and 32 2 × 1024 32^{2}\times 1024 , respectively. A separate 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution projects each map to 256 channels, producing { F l } l = 1 4 \{F_{l}\}_{l=1}^{4} .

At each scale, RoIAlign [ 4 ] extracts an appearance token from each of the K K exemplar boxes, while a shared lightweight MLP embeds each box’s normalized width and height into a size token. The K K appearance tokens and K K size tokens form E l ∈ ℝ 2 ​ K × 256 E_{l}\in\mathbb{R}^{2K\times 256} . Inspired by previous work [ 10 ] , a scale-specific query module (SQM) uses tokens from F l F_{l} as queries and E l E_{l} as keys and values. Cross-attention relates image locations to the exemplars’ appearance and size cues, and single-scale deformable attention [ 18 ] refines the resulting features, yielding { Q l } l = 1 4 \{Q_{l}\}_{l=1}^{4} .

K K 外观符号和 K K K 大小符号组成 E l ∈ R 2 K × 256 E_{l}\in\ mathbb{ R}^{2K\times 256}. 受到前作[10]的启发,一个比例特异性的查询模块(SQM)使用F l F_{l}的符号作为查询,E l E_{l}作为键和值. 交叉注意将图像位置与实例的外观和大小提示联系起来,单级可变形的注意[18] 完善了由此产生的特征,产生{Ql}l=1 4 \{Q_{l=1}^{4}.

blocks.en: In crowded regions, closely spaced instances can produce overlapping responses on the score map, leaving fewer distinct peaks than annotated targets. Peak-based matching may therefore leave some targets without a positive query. Missed-object recovery (Fig. 2 (a)) extends supervision to these targets by assigning them unused dense queries. Candidate reference positions r i r_{i} are searched within a 5 × 5 5\times 5 grid neighborhood of each unmatched annotation g j g_{j} , followed by a 7 × 7 7\times 7 search for any remaining targets. A joint one-to-one assignment minimizes the total reference-to-annotation ℓ 1 \ell_{1} distance while reserving queries accepted by the initial matching. This gives nearby targets distinct training queries.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: 3.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 实验设置

blocks.en: Implementation details. AgriCountDINO uses a frozen DINOv3-pretrained ConvNeXt-B encoder [ 14 , 6 ] . Images are resized to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 , with up to three exemplar boxes used during training. The trainable parameters are optimized for 100 epochs with AdamW [ 7 ] , a learning rate and weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , an effective batch size of 32, and BF16 mixed precision. The matching weights are λ p = 1 \lambda_{p}=1 and λ s = 2 \lambda_{s}=2 ; the loss weights are λ loc = 1 \lambda_{\mathrm{loc}}=1 , λ xy = 0.5 \lambda_{\mathrm{xy}}=0.5 , and λ peak = 0.05 \lambda_{\mathrm{peak}}=0.05 . Recovery coordinate and peak losses are gradually introduced over the first eight epochs. The auxiliary weight is 0.3 when the smaller mean exemplar dimension is below 25 pixels, and zero otherwise.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 AgriContDINO使用冷冻的DINov3预装ConvNEXt-B编码器[14,6]. 图像的尺寸调整为1024×1024 1024\times 1024,在训练时最多使用三个实例盒. 可列车参数优化为100个有亚当W[7]的时代,学习速率和重量衰减为10−4 10−4},有效批量尺寸为32,BF16混合精度. 对应的重量为 λ p = 1\lambda _{ p }= s = 2\lambda _{ s}= 2;损失重量为 λ oc = 1\lambda _{\ mathrm{loc}}=1 , λ xy = 0.5\lambda _{\ mathrm{xy 0.5 , λ 峰 = 0.05\lambda _{\ mathrm{峰 }}= 0.05 . 在前8个纪元中逐渐引入了恢复坐标和峰值损失. 当较小的平均值示例维度低于25像素时,辅助重量为0.3,否则为0.

blocks.en: Datasets and metrics. AgriCountDINO is trained on the 7,000 images in the official TPC-268 training split and evaluated in one-shot and three-shot settings. MAE, RMSE, and R 2 R^{2} measure image-level counting accuracy. To assess the spatial distribution of predicted counts, GAME- L L [ 3 ] sums absolute count errors over 4 L 4^{L} image regions; we report levels L = 1 , 2 , 3 L=1,2,3 . This exposes regional errors that can cancel in the image-level count. Point-level precision and recall assess individual target localization. Zero-shot transfer is evaluated on the generic-object dataset FSC-147 without target-domain training or fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 数据集和衡量标准。 AgriContDINO在正式的TPC-268训练中接受了7000个图像的培训,并在一发和三发的环境下进行了评估。 MAE,RMSE,和R 2 R^{2}测量图像级别的计数精度. 为了评估预测数的空间分布,GAME-L L[3]对4个L 4^{L}图像区域进行绝对计数误差;我们报告L = 1、2、3 L= 1、2、3。 这暴露出区域错误,在图像级计数中可以取消. 点级精度和召回评估单个目标本地化. 在通用对象数据集FSC-147上评价零射线传输,不进行目标域训练或微调.

blocks.en: 3.3 Counting Accuracy and Spatial Localization
blocks.zh: 3.3 计算准确性和空间定位

blocks.en: With 8.40M trainable parameters, approximately one tenth of TasselNetV4’s, AgriCountDINO achieves the lowest TPC-268 validation MAE and RMSE in both exemplar settings (Table 1 ). In the three-shot setting, its MAE of 11.92 and RMSE of 28.55 reduce the corresponding errors of TasselNetV4 by 9.7% and 35.0%. With one exemplar, it obtains a validation MAE of 13.16. On the test split, the three-shot and one-shot MAEs are 21.76 and 22.03, compared with 22.95 and 22.20 for TasselNetV4.
blocks.zh: AgriCountDINO在8.40M可训练参数中,大约占TasselNetV4的十分之一,实现了两种实例环境中最低的TPC-268验证MAE和RMSE(表1)。 在三射设定中,其MAE为11.92,RMSE为28.55,将TasselNetV4的相应误差减少9.7%和35.0%. 有了一个例子,它就获得了13.16的MAE验证. 在试射分裂时,三发和一发的MAE为21.76和22.03,塔塞尔NetV4则分别为22.95和22.20.

blocks.en: To examine whether accurate counts are accompanied by accurate target placement, we also evaluate predicted point localization. In the three-shot setting, AgriCountDINO reduces GAME3 from 33.33 for TasselNetV4 to 25.37, a 23.9% reduction at the finest reported grid level (Table 2 ). Its predicted points achieve 0.719 precision and 0.729 recall. The examples in Fig. 3 show points aligned with individual targets, including closely spaced instances where TasselNetV4 produces broader counting responses.
blocks.zh: 为了检查准确的计数是否伴随着准确的目标定位,我们还评价了预测的点定位. 在三射场景中,AgriContDINO将GAME3从33.33的TasselNetV4减少到25.37,在最佳报告电网水平上减少了23.9%(表2)。 它的预测点达到了0.719的精确度和0.729的召回. 图3中的例子显示与个别目标一致的点数,包括TasselNetV4产生更广泛计数响应的密切间隔实例。

blocks.en: Remaining errors on the validation and test sets may arise from both difficult target configurations and annotation quality. Dense or visually ambiguous instances can challenge point prediction, while Fig. 4 shows examples of apparent discrepancies between visible targets and point annotations. A prediction on a plausible but unannotated target may therefore increase the measured error.
blocks.zh: 校验和测试集的其余错误可能来自困难的目标配置和注释质量。 浅显或视觉模糊的例子可以挑战点预测,而图4则显示了可见目标与点说明之间明显差异的例子. 因此,对一个可能但未经说明的目标的预测可能会增加所测误差。

blocks.en: 3.4 Zero-Shot Cross-Dataset Transfer
blocks.zh: 3.4 零同步交叉数据传输

blocks.en: Trained only on TPC-268, AgriCountDINO transfers directly to unseen generic object categories in FSC-147 without target-domain training or fine-tuning. Table 3 reports a zero-shot MAE of 14.25, improving on LOCA’s 15.16 by 6.0%. The FSC-147 examples in Fig. 3 further show that the model localizes individual targets in these unseen categories. These results suggest that the model captures transferable semantic correspondences between exemplars and target objects, enabling counting and localization beyond the agricultural categories seen during training.
blocks.zh: AgriContDINO只接受过TPC-268的培训,在FSC-147中直接转移到看不见的通用对象类别,没有目标领域培训或微调。 表3的MAE为14.25,比LOCA的15.16增加了6.0%。 FSC-147在图3中的例子进一步表明,模型在这些看不见的类别中将单个目标本地化. 这些结果表明,该模型能够捕捉实例与目标对象之间的可转移语义对应,使计数和本地化超越培训期间看到的农业类别。

blocks.en: 3.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 3.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: The ablations in Table 4 reveal distinct roles for the three components. Replacing DINOv3 with supervised ConvNeXt-B causes the largest increase in MAE (11.92 to 17.64), suggesting that the DINOv3 representation provides a stronger basis for relating exemplars to diverse plant targets. Removing scale-wise conditioning worsens both MAE and GAME3, indicating that exemplar guidance across the feature hierarchy contributes to accurate global and regional counts. Without missed-object recovery, point recall falls from 0.729 to 0.692 and MAE increases, consistent with more targets being omitted after initial peak matching. F1 remains unchanged, so the clearest contribution of recovery is improved instance coverage.
blocks.zh: 表4中的内容显示了这三个组成部分的不同作用。 以受监督的ConvNEXt-B取代DINOv3,使MAE(11.92至17.64)的增长幅度最大,这表明DINOv3代表为将实例与各种植物目标联系起来提供了更坚实的基础。 取消规模化的调制使MAE和GAME3都恶化,表明整个特征等级的示范指导有助于准确的全球和区域计数。 在不错失对象恢复的情况下,点召从0.729降至0.692,MAE增加,与初始峰值匹配后省略更多目标相一致. F1保持不变,因此恢复的最明显贡献是扩大了实例覆盖面。

blocks.en: 4 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We introduced AgriCountDINO, a parameter-efficient model for exemplar-guided counting and localization of plants and plant organs. It conditions frozen multiscale DINOv3 features on exemplar appearance and size, then predicts individual target points whose number gives the count. With 8.4M trainable parameters, AgriCountDINO achieves lower validation counting and spatial errors than TasselNetV4 on TPC-268. It also obtains the lowest zero-shot MAE among the compared methods on FSC-147 without target-domain fine-tuning. These results demonstrate AgriCountDINO’s ability to combine accurate counting, instance localization, and transfer beyond the agricultural categories used for training.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍阿格里肯特 DINO,是植物和植物器官的示范制导计数和本地化的参数高效模型. 它在实例外观和大小上条件冻结多尺度的DINOv3特性,然后预测单个目标点,其数字给出计数. 有了8.4M可列车参数,AgriContDINO在TPC-268上实现了比TasselNetV4更低的验证计数和空间误差. 在FSC-147上的比较方法中,它也获得了最低的零射程MAE,没有目标域微调. 这些结果显示,AgriContDINO有能力将准确的计数、例如本地化和转移结合起来,超越用于培训的农业类别。
